name: BOUML
description: A cross-platform UML modeling tool with C++ and Java plugin support whose published update history ended in 2021.
editorialNote: Imported from the UMLChina UML tools collection. The English summary is a concise editorial translation; capability fields remain Unknown unless the source explicitly states support.
sourceDescriptionZh: 支持C++和Java编写的插件。版本更新频率很快。

codeGeneration.note: The official licensing page explicitly covers built-in language generators.

reverseEngineering.note: The official licensing page explicitly covers language reverse-engineering tools.

classificationNotes: BOUML 7.x is free to use, while only selected plug-outs are GPL-licensed; the current application is therefore classified Source Available rather than Open Source.
